messages:
Raj Kapoor: FYI - Orion just flagged a lane capacity issue, partial manifests held at NL crossdock. ETA slipped ~5 days. Affects two private deploy shipments and one Dedicated commit.
Olivia Chen: ugh. Which manifests / reservation ids?
Raj Kapoor: IDs: `RES-98421`, `RES-98422` (private EU racks), `DED-7334` (dedicated pool). Orion says manifest MNL-2221 is >70% blocked.
Orion Logistics Rep: Sorry folks — unexpected port congestion + container reallocation. We can release ~30% of units this week, next tranche earliest Fri. Air freight is an option but cost >2x.
Maria Gomez: @Orion Logistics Rep can you confirm which SKUs can be prioritized? Private deploy needs whole racks (unit type: rtx-a1-rack).
Orion Logistics Rep: Prioritizable: rtx-a1-rack serial ranges 6000-6027 (approx 14 racks). The rest will be delayed.
Zack Lee: We have 18 racks reserved for the private EU customer (RES-98421/22). If 14 are available we still short 4. Can we swap 4 from the Dedicated pool (DED-7334) temporarily?
Claire Wu: That will impact committed Dedicated throughput for a week but better than missed private SLO. What's commercial impact?
Raj Kapoor: Quick commercial note: private customer has a launch dependency next-mon -> SLA risk. Dedicated customer has throughput buffer for ~48h but not a week. Recommend: 4 racks from DED -> private, rest matched by partial air uplift.
Olivia Chen: Also need marketplace/reservation bookkeeping. If we move 4 racks from DED to RES we must update billing and note crediting. PartnerOpsBot: Auto-note: create swap-ticket #CS-9271 and tag finance for pro-rata credit.
Maria Gomez: Can we get Orion's ETA for the remaining racks if we air-uplift 6 racks?
Orion Logistics Rep: If air uplift for 6 racks: those can clear customs within 48h and be in EU DC by +3 days. Ground remainder arrives +6 days.
Zack Lee: Proposed plan: (1) Move 4 racks DED->RES-98421/22 (2) Air uplift 6 racks for private (cost to be billed to optional contingency) (3) Remaining 8 racks accept +6d delay and update canary schedules.
Claire Wu: Approve plan contingent on Finance sign-off on air uplift charging to contingency. Need an entry for customer comms template.
Raj Kapoor: I'll draft comms. Quick template: "we're reassigning a small portion of capacity to ensure launch continuity; you'll receive tracking and updated SLA credits if needed." Keep it short.
Olivia Chen: Raj drop the draft here and @Claire will route to finance. Also please run impact check on Dedicated tps metrics (Zack).
Zack Lee: Running quick perf-impact simulation now, will post numbers in ~20m.
PartnerOpsBot: Ticket created: CS-9271 (capacity-swap). Assigned: Maria Gomez, Raj Kapoor.
Maria Gomez: OK taking ownership of orchestration with Orion. I'll confirm serials to be swapped and upload manifest changes when available.
Raj Kapoor: Thanks all. If anything changes ping @here.
Orion Logistics Rep: We'll follow up with updated manifest by EOD. Apologies for the disruption. :pray:
